title: NYUAD at ImageEval Shared Tasks: A Multimodal LLM for Audio-Visual Question Answering and Hallucination Detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic
abstract: arXiv:2611.18610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The increasing adoption of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has enabled more natural interaction with visual and spoken information, creating new opportunities for intelligent audio-visual question answering (AVQA) and hallucination detection systems. AVQA extends traditional visual question answering by requiring models to jointly understand an input image and a spoken question to generate accurate, context-aware responses. Despite recent advances, AVQA and hallucination detection tasks remain challenging for modern standard Arabic (MSA) due to the limited availability of multimodal datasets and the need to reason across Arabic speech and text modalities alongside visual inputs. In this paper, we present an MLLM-based framework for AVQA that takes an image and a spoken question as input and generates answers. In addition, we utilized this framework to detect hallucination in text-image pairs. The proposed approach is evaluated o

translated_title: 纽约大学阿布扎比分校参加ImageEval共享任务：一个用于英语和现代标准阿拉伯语的视听问答与幻觉检测的多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的日益普及使得与视觉和语音信息的交互更加自然，为智能视听问答（AVQA）和幻觉检测系统创造了新的机遇。AVQA扩展了传统的视觉问答，要求模型联合理解输入图像和语音提问，以生成准确且具备上下文感知的回答。尽管近期取得了进展，但由于多模态数据集的匮乏以及需要跨阿拉伯语语音、文本模态与视觉输入进行推理，AVQA和幻觉检测任务对于现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）而言仍然充满挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于MLLM的AVQA框架，该框架以图像和语音提问作为输入并生成答案。此外，我们利用该框架来检测文本-图像对中的幻觉。所提出的方法在（此处摘要原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于多模态大语言模型的统一框架，能够处理英语和现代标准阿拉伯语的视听问答任务，并检测文本-图像对中的幻觉现象。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified multimodal LLM-based framework for audio-visual question answering and hallucination detection in text-image pairs, supporting both English and Modern Standard Arabic.
